title: Deep_Silence
name: Deep_Silence
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Beneath the weight of endless sea,
Where light can never reach to free,
A city sleeps in deep decay,
Its streets forever washed away.

[Chorus]
Silent abyss below the wave,
The forgotten world God couldn't save,
Echoes linger in the cold,
A story time can never hold.

[Verse 2]
Coral threads through window frames,
The ghosts of neon lost in flames,
What once was bright now finds its rest,
Deep below the ocean's breast.

[Chorus]
Silent abyss below the wave,
The forgotten world God couldn't save,
Silence broken by no sound,
The deepest peace that can be found.

lyrics:

The moon hangs low behind the walls

[Chorus]
Silent depths beneath the skin
Where broken tides begin again
We drift alone through empty space
And find the light in hollowing

[Verse 2]
The ocean hums a low monotone
A distant star, a broken stone
What whispers through the empty air
Are echoes only night can share

[Chorus]
Silent depths beneath the skin
Where broken tides begin again
We drift alone through empty space
And find the light in hollowing

And in the hush between each wave

[Chorus]
Silent depths beneath the skin

title: FathomlessTide
name: FathomlessTide
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Beneath the surface deep and wide,
where silence folds like ocean tide,
I drift through corridors of thought,
where faded memories are brought.

[Chorus]
Fathomless tide, it pulls me in,
through corridors where light grows thin,
the weight of worlds I cannot hold,
still stories left for those untold.

[Verse 2]
The current carries what remains,
of fragments lost in endless trains,
through hollow halls I make my way,
to find the end of yesterday.

[Chorus]
Fathomless tide, it pulls me in,
through corridors where light grows thin,
the weight of worlds I cannot hold,
still stories left for those untold.

[Outro]
Fathomless tide...

title: Cosmic Drift
name: Cosmic Drift
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Stars are falling through the night
Silent rivers guide the light
In the hollow of the sky
Where the wandering souls cry

[Chorus]
Dreaming in the cosmic sea
Floating weightlessly
Through the cracks of universe
We were never meant to be found

[Verse 2]
Moonlit shadows drift apart
Echoes fade from every heart
In the silence deep below
All the silver rivers flow

[Chorus]
Dreaming in the cosmic sea
Floating weightlessly
Through the cracks of universe

title: Fading_into_Dawn
name: Fading_into_Dawn
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Fog drapes the sleeping city streets,
Stars fade where silence meets,
A broken world beneath the moon,
Waiting for the light to bloom.

[Chorus]
Fading into dawn, the dream's edge line,
Between the dark and the first sign,
Whispers carry through the haze,
As night dissolves in pale gold rays.

[Verse 2]
Ghosts of stars still cling to sky,
The soul drifts where worlds collide,
On the border of sleep and wake,
A breath of hope the silence took.

[Chorus]
Fading into dawn, the dream's edge line,
Between the dark and the first sign,
Whispers carry through the haze,
As night dissolves in pale gold rays.

[Bridge]
Then light breaks through the cracks of dream,
A warmth that makes the shadow gleam.

[Chorus]
Fading into dawn, the dream's edge line,
Between the dark and the first sign,
Whispers carry through the haze,
As dawn becomes the final phrase.

title: Whispers_Before_Dawn
name: Whispers_Before_Dawn
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There's a silence at the edge of night
When the world forgets to breathe
I'm holding on to something slipping away
Like a thought I can't retrieve

[Chorus]
Whispers before dawn
secrets no one knows
The sky is turning gold
But I'm still holding onto ghosts

[Verse 2]
Every star is fading into blue
Every shadow starts to fade
I can almost see the morning coming through
But I'm not quite ready to be saved

[Chorus]
Whispers before dawn
The light begins to grow
The night releases me
But I'm still here, not quite letting go

title: Whispers_Before_the_Breaking
name: Whispers_Before_the_Breaking
lyrics:
🎤 Whispers Before the Breaking — Instrumental Track

[Lyrics — wordless vocal意象, no dialogue, purely atmospheric]

This track is instrumental. The "lyrics" exist as emotional layers:

Verse 1 — silence
Soft breath, ambient space, held.

Verse 2 — the hum
A distant wordless vocal, just vowel sounds, no words.
(Hums in Cm: E♭ — D — C — B♭)

Chorus — the swell
Pad swells upward, filtered, building.
Then release — returning to silence.

Bridge — the shimmer
High harmonics appear, glass-like, fading.

Final fade — silence again.

[Total lyrics: Instrumental / Wordless / Emotional atmosphere only]

title: Whispers Between Stars
name: Whispers Between Stars
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Between the cracks in endless night,
A whisper rides on fractured light,
The stars breathe slow, the silence calls,
A dreaming world behind these walls.

[Chorus]
Whispers between stars we hear,
In twilight depths, so cold, so clear,
We float through spaces none can name,
And find ourselves without a frame.

[Verse 2]
The mist hangs low on dreaming shores,
No footstep marks what dream restores,
Behind the veil of sleep we drift,
Where fading light and hope feels shift.

[Chorus]
Whispers between stars we hear,
In twilight depths, so cold, so clear,
We float through spaces none can name,
And find ourselves without a frame.

title: Whispers Before the Horizon
name: Whispers Before the Horizon
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The world holds its breath tonight,
Stars bleed into the sea of sky.
I walk where shadows meet the light,
A silent pilgrim passing by.

[Chorus]
Whispers before the horizon calls,
Through the haze I hear your name.
Before the dawn rewrites it all,
I'll keep this moment, keep this flame.

[Verse 2]
Fog rolls across the sleeping fields,
A silver curtain, thin and white.
Each heartbeat a tomorrow yields,
Each silence tastes like fading light.

[Chorus]
Whispers before the horizon calls,
Through the haze I hear your name.
Before the dawn rewrites it all,
I'll keep this moment, keep this flame.

[Bridge]
And when the first gold cracks the edge of night,
I won't look back — I'll step into the bright.

[Outro]
Whispers before the horizon...

lyrics:

空房间还没有醒

算了 再睡一会儿就好了
